title: Asian Veggie Ground Noodle Soup with Swiss Chard, Mushrooms & Lime

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.

While the pot heats up, fold chard leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves into bite-sized pieces and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Place leaves in another medium bowl, reserving stems for the next step.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger, garlic, mushrooms, chard stems, veggie ground, and spices. Cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until the veggie ground is browned and crumbly and chard stems are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add broth, water, and soy sauce to the pot. Stir to combine, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the broth is boiling, uncover, add rice noodles, and stir to combine the soup. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until noodles are almost soft, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the chard leaves. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
When the noodles are almost soft, add chard leaves, cilantro, and green onions to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Continue to cook until noodles and chard leaves are tender, 1-2 minutes more.
Juice lime into the pot, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls, then top with reserved cilantro and green onions. Enjoy!
